constraints.description: AgentGate registry, staged coverage and collision signal
Boots the starfield background, validates the default scenario/world wiring
Guards the public GameState facade against domain-split drift
Central docs integrity: duplicated headings/table blocks, broken markdown table structure

execution_model.description: No parallel workers in Godot 4.7 - OS.execute from threads is unreliable. Sequential execution with shared in-memory CodeIndex.
execution_model.fixture_sharing: V2Fixture boots scene ONCE, then uses reset_state() between constraints. Full reboot after destructive constraints (save_game_roundtrip, context_handover).
execution_model.state_reset: Checkpoint/verify system in V2Context captures ownership, resources, techs, upgrades, worker counts, transit count, node count before each constraint. verify_checkpoint() runs after each constraint and records isolation_warnings.

mcp_json_output.format: JSON with ok, verdict, constraints (total/passed/failed), assertions (run/passed/failed), duration_ms, timings (per constraint), failures

watchdog_timeout.behavior: Creates timer, on timeout prints ABORT message and exits with code 124

cheap_path_vs_full_path.python_only: Marked as 'python' severity in agent_activity.sh classify_file(). Uses cheap-path without scene preflight. Constraint 'agent_activity' is pure and delegates to hook.
cheap_path_vs_full_path.code_changes: Marked as 'scoped' or 'full' severity. Uses DOKI scope/full preflight. ChangeImpactResolver resolves staged files to contracts to constraints.

result_caching.mechanism: HEAD-keyed cache in test_all.gd (not in preflight.gd directly). test_all.gd caches entry test results by file digest + git write-tree hash.
result_caching.preflight_caching: Preflight is NEVER cached (line 90 in test_all.gd: 'Preflight wird nie gecacht (Full-Run-Garantie bleibt beim Hook)')

reload_api_usage.method: load() gets cached script, then source_code overwritten with disk content, then reload() called
reload_api_usage.reason: load() returns Script even on parse error; reload() returns ERR_PARSE_ERROR deterministically

evidence_output.atomic_write: Write to tmp, then rename_absolute to final path
evidence_output.cleanup: Stale PID tmp files cleaned up on each run

failure_modes.already_in_use: ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE means live instances exist (resources loaded at startup) - counted as live_verified

test_all.note: 21 test files discovered by glob, but test_all.gd filters for *_test.gd excluding dbg_* - actual count varies

cache_mechanism.key: git write-tree hash + file SHA-256 digest

options.TEST_ALL_FILTER: Run only tests with term in path
options.TEST_ALL_TIMEOUT: Optional timeout per test (default 0 = no timeout)

checks: Rebase detection (skips if rebase in progress)
Amend detection (skips if HEAD is DOKI commit and session idle)
.commit_msg.txt must exist and not be empty
Ownership token must match (single active owner)
Snapshot gate: staged files must match session snapshot (excluding auto-managed)
Scope gate: resolved verification scope must match prepare scope
Byte drift gate: staged bytes must match prepare digest
Path drift gate: staged path set must match prepare digest
Path gate: staged files must match snapshot

check_in.collision_detection: Fails if another ACTIVE agent has same file (unless AGENT_ACTIVITY_ADOPT_SCOPE=1)

prune.stale_detection: STALE if age > TTL (2700s), RECHECK-REQUIRED if age > 3600s, NO-OUT if age > 7200s or beat <= 0
prune.force_flag: --force removes registry and files, --purge removes archive too

doki_integration.prepare_flow_requires: AGENT_NAME and AGENT_ACTIVITY_SEED env vars from check-in
doki_integration.gate_flow_checks: Ownership token validation, session state VERIFIED

staging_commit_flow.git_add_pattern: Explicit files only (AGENTS.md: 'Kein git add -A'), DOKI stages narrative artifacts automatically
staging_commit_flow.commit_message: .commit_msg.txt generated by DOKI finish_flow, then 'git commit -F .commit_msg.txt'

doki_sequence.prepare: doki prepare '<impuls>' - resolves impact, writes .doki/scope.json, .doki/agent_binding.json, generates prompt
doki_sequence.gate: doki gate (or gate_flow) - validates session, scope, byte/path drift, ownership
doki_sequence.finish: doki finish --body-file .doki/narrator_body.md - runs 10 checks, writes .commit_msg.txt, change_index.json, CHANGELOG.md, stages them
doki_sequence.finalize: doki finalize - appends to narrative_chain.json, advances arcs, stages chain/index/arcs for next commit

scope_determination.agents_md_rule: Stage-Set ist die Coverage-Quelle; manuelle 166-Datei-Listen sind nicht zulässig (AGENTS.md:7)

flow.3_prepare: DOKI prepare_flow runs ChangeImpactResolver.resolve(staged) -> {constraints, contracts, paths}
flow.5_gate: GateFlow re-resolves scope from full staged (including auto-managed) and compares to prepare scope

bypasses.manual_scope_override: preflight.gd --scope=<manifest> or --scope=<csv> bypasses ChangeImpactResolver (fails if unknown/empty)
bypasses.stale_agent_takeover: agent_activity.sh takeover --from <stale_agent> --reason <...> allowed only for stale/NO-OUT agents without ACTIVE collision
bypasses.adopt_scope: AGENT_ACTIVITY_ADOPT_SCOPE=1 allows check-in despite active other lock

files: constraint_scanner.gd - Dynamic constraint discovery + canonical contract/path mappings
v2_context.gd - PreflightV2Context with checkpointing, phase tracking, fail-fast flag
v2_fixture.gd - V2Fixture wraps PreflightFixture, adds reset_state() for lightweight resets
change_impact_resolver.gd - Staged files -> contracts -> constraint closure (fail-closed)
preflight_code_index.gd - Shared in-memory codebase index (built once, used by all pure constraints)

differences_from_v1.v1_location: scripts/preflight.gd (original) - now replaced by v2 entry point
differences_from_v1.v2_entry_point: scripts/preflight.gd now imports and uses v2 modules
key_improvements: Single scene boot + state resets instead of full reboot per constraint
Shared CodeIndex built once for all pure constraints
Checkpoint/verify system for state isolation detection
Fail-fast flag instead of tree.quit(1) - allows summary to print
Phase separation: pure (no scene) then scene (shared fixture)

anomalies.description: No git hooks found in .git/hooks/ directory. AGENTS.md mandates pre-commit, prepare-commit-msg, commit-msg, post-commit hooks but none exist.
anomalies.impact: AgentGate check-in, DOKI gate, preflight verification not enforced at commit time

anomalies.description: Preflight not integrated into git hooks. AGENTS.md says 'Der Hook führt AgentGate einmal aus' but no hook exists to run it.
anomalies.evidence: AGENTS.md:10 mentions hook runs AgentGate; .git/hooks/ empty
anomalies.impact: Verification runs only manually, not automatically on commit

anomalies.description: Scope resolution fails closed for unknown paths, but _PATH_CONTRACTS may not cover all repo paths. Unmapped paths cause prepare to fail.
anomalies.evidence: change_impact_resolver.gd:74-76 returns error 'unknown_impact' for unmapped paths
anomalies.impact: New file patterns not in _PATH_CONTRACTS block commits until mappings added

anomalies.description: agent_activity.sh staged_files() uses git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR. Renames (R) and copies (C) with different names may not be captured correctly.
anomalies.impact: Renamed/copied files may not be included in scope

anomalies.description: test_all.gd cache keyed by git write-tree hash. If working tree has unstaged changes, write-tree still reflects HEAD, not working state. Cache may incorrectly hit.
anomalies.evidence: test_all.gd:190-193 _current_tree_hash() uses 'git write-tree' which only reflects staged/index state
anomalies.impact: Cache hits may occur even when unstaged changes affect test behavior

anomalies.description: Constraint registry in constraint_scanner.gd has 44 constraints, but _CONTRACT_CONSTRAINTS maps only 43 unique constraint IDs (module_damage_model appears in both 'ships' and 'combat'). Some constraints may not be in any contract.
anomalies.impact: Constraints not in any contract will never run in scoped mode

anomalies.description: Watchdog/timeout disabled by default (0 = no timeout) for preflight, compile_gate, and test_all. Long-running hangs possible.
anomalies.impact: No automatic abort on infinite loops or deadlocks

anomalies.description: Two preflight systems coexist: v1 (scripts/preflight/constraint_*.gd - 44 constraint implementations) and v2 (scripts/preflight_v2/ - runner, scanner, context, fixture). v2 entry point is scripts/preflight.gd which imports v2 modules but constraints remain in v1 directory.
anomalies.evidence: preflight.gd:10-13 imports v2 modules; constraint files in scripts/preflight/; v2 modules in scripts/preflight_v2/
anomalies.impact: Confusion about which is 'source of truth'; v1 constraints not migrated to v2 structure

anomalies.description: Original preflight.gd (v1) appears to have been replaced by v2 entry point. No legacy preflight.gd backup found.
anomalies.evidence: scripts/preflight.gd is now the v2 runner (extends SceneTree, uses v2 modules)
anomalies.impact: If v2 has bugs, no fallback to v1

anomalies.description: constraint_agent_activity.gd delegates to hook with check(true, 'AgentGate: delegated to pre-commit hook') - always passes. If hook missing (ANOM-001), this constraint provides zero verification.
anomalies.impact: False green in preflight when hooks not installed

anomalies.description: GateFlow validates byte/path drift against prepare digests, but if user stages additional files after prepare, gate fails. However, user could unstage files and re-run prepare - but DOKI doesn't prevent this workflow gap.
anomalies.impact: User can bypass scope validation by re-running prepare after modifying staging

anomalies.description: Auto-managed files (narrative_chain.json, change_index.json, CHANGELOG.md, .commit_msg.txt, arcs.json) excluded from snapshot/path/byte drift checks. If these are manually modified, drift not detected.
anomalies.impact: Manual edits to DOKI artifacts could slip through
